# TrustMyLab — Multi-Tenant Diagnostic Laboratory Management System (LIMS)
> https://trustmylab.in

TrustMyLab is a modern cloud-native, multi-tenant Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) built for clinical pathology laboratories, imaging & radiology centers, and diagnostic hospital networks.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Biological Reference Calculation**: Dynamic flagging of normal, high, low, and critical values based on patient age, gender, and clinical panel rules (CBC, LFT, KFT, Lipid, Thyroid).
- **Tamper-Proof QR Medical Reports**: High-precision PDF generation with cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 digital verification seals and instant online patient QR verification.
- **Referring Doctor Commission Settlement**: Automated calculation of referring doctor percentages/fixed payouts, printable billing statements, and payment reconciliation.
- **Multi-Tenant Cryptographic Isolation**: Strict tenant isolation at the ORM layer ensuring 100% data privacy between pathology laboratories.
- **Ultrasound & X-Ray Template Authoring**: WYSIWYG clinical template engine for ultrasound (USG), radiological impressions, and standardized pathology findings.
- **Automated Communication**: Instant WhatsApp, SMS, and email notifications for booking confirmation, sample collection, and report readiness.

## User Roles & RBAC Matrix
- **Super Admin**: Platform-wide tenant onboarding, laboratory suspension, global test catalog, and platform SEO/system settings.
- **Lab Admin**: Laboratory workstation management, staff roster provisioning, letterhead branding, and doctor commission rates.
- **Pathologist / Radiologist**: Workstation verification, test result validation, biological interpretation, and digital report signing.
- **Lab Assistant / Phlebotomist**: Patient intake, sample draw tracking, barcode assignment, and worklist management.
- **Receptionist**: Patient booking, instant thermal receipt printing, payment collection, and report delivery.
- **Patient**: Self-service portal to view appointment history, download finalized PDF reports, and verify digital credentials.
